definitions.explanation: A body or form that is soft and flexible, lacking hard skeletal structure. Most commonly encountered in the compound {軟体動物|なんたいどうぶつ} (mollusk), but also used independently to describe flexibility.

examples.japanese: タコ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{軟体|なんたい}{動物|どうぶつ}です。

{軟体|なんたい}{動物|どうぶつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{骨|ほね}→骨：02166_hone⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦{狭|せま}い→狭い：00750_semai⟧⟦{隙間|すきま}→隙間：00389_sukima⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{入|はい}れる→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: Soft-bodied animals have no bones, so they can fit into narrow gaps.

examples.japanese: イカや⟦{貝|かい}→貝：02145_kai⟧⟦など→〜など：03095_nado⟧、{軟体|なんたい}{動物|どうぶつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{種類|しゅるい}→種類：01560_shurui⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{世界中|せかいじゅう}→世界中：10171_sekaijuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{約|やく}→約：09563_yaku⟧10{万|まん}⟦{種|しゅ}→種：28584_shu⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: It is said that there are approximately 100,000 species of mollusks, including squid and shellfish, worldwide.

notes:
Combines {軟|なん} (soft) and ⟦{体|たい}→体：09872_tai⟧ (body). Almost always encountered in the compound ⟦{軟体動物|なんたいどうぶつ}→軟体動物：23827_nantaidoubutsu⟧ (mollusks — the phylum Mollusca), which includes snails, clams, octopuses, and squid. Also used figuratively to describe a person with unusual flexibility.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {軟体|なんたい}{動物|どうぶつ}: mollusk (the most common usage)
- {軟体|なんたい}{動物|どうぶつ}⟦{門|もん}→門：14603_mon⟧: phylum Mollusca
- {軟体|なんたい}⟦{生物|せいぶつ}→生物：03295_seibutsu⟧: soft-bodied organism
